basic_info.description:
Experience modern comfort in this light-filled home featuring an open floor plan and a private balcony with the widest bay views in the community. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath layout is thoughtfully designed for maximum privacy and includes freshly painted interiors and brand-new carpet.
Enjoy bamboo flooring, a sleek gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar, plus a luxurious primary suite with a walk-in closet and en-suite bath. In-unit laundry adds convenience.
Located just minutes from downtown SF and SFO, with secured parking and easy access to Highway 101. The community also provides a free shuttle to BART and Caltrain stations. With parks, waterfront trails, and open spaces just across the street, this is Bay Area living at its finest.
